name: Asanbosam OLD
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

offensiveAbilities.name: Attack from Above
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The asanbosam is positioned above a creature

Effect The asanbosam makes a claw Strike with its reach increased to 15 feet. On a hit, the Strike deals an additional 1d6 Slashing Damage damage and the asanbosam immediately Grabs the target and pulls it to a space adjacent to the asanbosam.

This counts as two attacks for the asanbosam's multiple attack penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drink Blood
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, Unconscious, or willing creature is within reach of the asanbosam's jaws

Effect The asanbosam sinks its teeth into the creature to drink its blood. If the victim is grabbed, this is automatic; otherwise, the asanbosam must succeed at an athletics|defense:fortitude check against the victim's Fortitude DC. The victim becomes Drained 1 and the asanbosam regains 10 Healing Damage HP, gaining any excess Hit Points beyond its maximum as temporary Hit Points. These temporary Hit Points remain for 1 minute.

Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained increases the victim's drained value by 1 to a maximum of drained 3, but doesn't restore any HP to the asanbosam.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 each week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful DC 20 Medicine check and a blood donor or sufficient blood, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
